$comment: One entry per variant. Sizes are pixels on the output canvas. `source` picks which recordings a preset uses: portrait (phone) or landscape (laptop). Add a variant by adding an entry; scripts/variants.mjs reads this file.

presets.name: reel
presets.about: 9:16 for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts. The bottom 15% stays clear for the platform's own caption and buttons.

presets.name: wide-phone
presets.about: 16:9 for YouTube, X and LinkedIn from a phone recording: the phone on the left, the hook and captions on the right.

presets.name: wide-laptop
presets.about: 16:9 for YouTube, X and LinkedIn from a laptop recording, framed at 75% with the hook above it.

presets.name: wide-laptop-zoom
presets.about: wide-laptop, zooming in on each highlighted part (found from the dimmed band) and back out when it ends.

presets.name: web
presets.about: For a website: the plain clip, its .vtt captions and poster, and embed.html showing how a page frames it. Nothing is burned in.
